description: This line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across 64 relation categories for three different experimental configurations: “w/o DPO obo” (blue solid line with circle markers), “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange solid line with triangle markers), and “DPO” (green solid line with square markers). The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” spans integer values from 0 to 63, representing discrete relation types. The y-axis, labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.6 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot also includes three horizontal dashed lines indicating the overall average repetition rate for each configuration: 0.227 for “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange dashed), 0.163 for “w/o DPO obo” (blue dashed), and 0.117 for “DPO” (green dashed). The blue line (“w/o DPO obo”) exhibits high variability, peaking sharply at category 2 (≈0.6) and showing multiple local maxima and minima. The orange line (“w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”) also fluctuates significantly, with peaks near categories 2, 18, 32, and 45, and generally remains above the blue line’s average. The green line (“DPO”) remains relatively stable and consistently low, mostly below 0.2, with minor fluctuations and a slight upward trend toward the end. The shaded gray region highlights the range between the orange and blue dashed average lines, visually emphasizing the performance gap between the two non-DPO configurations.
